additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391858-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/10] Missing power converter CRM:00641000791
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope this message finds you well.
Regarding the reported issue, it has been observed that a "Missing Converter" error in DC2 has occurred, along with error E17, which indicates an
Internal Communication Error
.
In such cases, the converter wiring might be loose. We recommend verifying the connections with the help of the troubleshooting document.
If all the wiring is properly secured, it is likely that one of the converters may be faulty or damaged.
The converter reporting the issue to the SCB is likely the one that needs replacement or further investigation.
Kindly refer the attached troubleshooting document so trace out the issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
and please ensure to carry a spare converter in case a replacement is required.
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
For future reference, your ticket number is ID0391858, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
